title: Topic 1: Sports & Outdoor Activities
content:
1. Do you play any sports regularly or prefer watching sports on television?

questions.answer: I am a big fan of playing sports regularly rather than just watching them on television.
questions.example: I usually play badminton with my close friends at a local court every Tuesday and Saturday evening.
questions.q: 1. Play sports regularly or prefer watching on TV?
questions.reason: This is because playing sports is beneficial to my physical health; it helps me keep fit, strengthen my immune system, and reduce stress after studying.

questions.answer: Joining competitive sports brings many benefits to both our physical health and social life.
questions.example: For example, when my university class joined a football tournament last month, we practiced together and built stronger friendships.
questions.reason: Besides helping us get into good shape and feel more energetic, team competitions teach us teamwork and let us meet like-minded people.

questions.answer: In the future, I would like to try swimming or hiking in the mountains.
questions.example: Next summer, I plan to sign up for a weekend swimming class at the sports center near my house.
questions.q: 3. New sport or physical activity to try in the future
questions.reason: Swimming is great for physical fitness without hurting our joints, while hiking helps me relax my mind in fresh air.

title: Part 2 - Situation 1: Choosing a Weekend Activity for a 10-Year-Old Cousin
content:
Situation: Your 10-year-old cousin is visiting your city for the weekend, and you want to organize a fun and memorable outing. There are three options:
- Visiting the city zoo (đi sở thú)
- Going to a modern shopping mall (đi trung tâm thương mại mua sắm)
- Attending a live performance at the children's theater (đi xem kịch tại nhà hát thiếu nhi)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because it is easy to walk around together, so my cousin and I can see many animals, share good snacks, and chat comfortably without any complicated preparation.

khen2ARE.answer: Visiting the city zoo gives my 10-year-old cousin the opportunity to increase knowledge and broaden his horizons about wildlife and nature.
khen2ARE.example: For example, we can walk through the green park area together, watch the elephant feeding show, and take fun photos to show his parents back home.
khen2ARE.reason: Instead of only looking at pictures on a phone screen, watching real animals helps him gain a deeper understanding of living creatures while staying active outdoors.

chosen.khen3Text: the best way to help both of us forget about study pressure, refresh our minds, and take meaningful photos together.

rejected.option: Going to a modern shopping mall
rejected.reason: walking inside a crowded, noisy shopping mall easily makes a child feel tired, and it often tempts buyers to waste money on expensive toys instead of enjoying a memorable weekend outing.

rejected.option: Attending a live performance at the children's theater
rejected.reason: sitting still in a dark theater for two hours does not allow us to move around or talk freely, and this opinion has received little agreement from kids his age.

title: Part 3 - Topic 1: The Impact of Parenting Styles on Children's Development
content:
Topic: How parental behavior and guidance shape children's development
Suggestions:
- Fostering self-confidence and emotional resilience
- Shaping moral values, honesty, and social manners
- Influencing academic success and future career orientation
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. Is strict parenting or lenient parenting more effective in raising well-behaved children?
2. How does modern screen time affect interactions between parents and their children?
3. What can society do to support parents who have hectic work schedules?

hint.coreTopic: how parenting styles shape children's development

followUps.answer: I think a balanced parenting style is much better than being too strict or too soft.
followUps.example: For example, parents can set clear bedtime rules, while still letting teenagers choose their own hobbies on weekends.
followUps.formula: Do you think / Choice -> Balanced Answer + Reason
followUps.q: Is strict parenting or lenient parenting more effective in raising well-behaved children?
followUps.reason: This is because being too strict creates family conflicts and stress, while having no rules causes children to lack self-control and pick up bad behaviors.

followUps.answer: Too much screen time weakens communication and widens the generation gap between parents and children.
followUps.example: For instance, during family dinners, children often watch videos on tablets instead of sharing stories about their school day.
followUps.q: How does modern screen time affect interactions between parents and their children?
followUps.reason: This is because family members spend hours looking at phones instead of talking face-to-face, so they fail to understand each other.

followUps.answer: I think companies and authorities should offer flexible working hours and build affordable preschools near neighborhoods.
followUps.example: For example, companies can allow working parents to start work thirty minutes later after dropping their kids at school.
followUps.q: What can society do to support parents who have hectic work schedules?
followUps.reason: Sending young children to safe preschools lets parents work full-time without worry, while flexible hours help them reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

mindmapPoints.expand: This is because supportive parents listen to their children's worries calmly and guide them instead of shouting or leaving them alone.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for children's mental health and makes them feel safe and happy.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Good parenting helps children build self-confidence and strong mental health.

mindmapPoints.cue: Shaping moral values, honesty, and social manners
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, when parents share housework and speak politely at home, children learn to respect others and avoid bad behaviors.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to children as they adjust and adapt to the social environment.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Parents play an essential role in teaching children honesty and good manners.

mindmapPoints.cue: Influencing academic success and future career orientation
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because parents who encourage reading and support their children's interests help them gain knowledge and choose a job they truly enjoy.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on their education and future living standard.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Parenting styles affect children's school results and future career choices.

hint.ownIdea: I think that 3 ideas are comprehensive. I cannot think of other ideas.

reach a healthy balance between work and family time

Tiêu đề đề bài: Topic 2: Types of Schools & Traffic Conditions
Nội dung chi tiết:
1. Did you attend a public school or a private school when you were younger?
2. What are the key differences between private schools and public schools in your country?
3. How severe is traffic congestion in your hometown during rush hours?
title: Topic 2: Types of Schools & Traffic Conditions
content:
1. Did you attend a public school or a private school when you were younger?
2. What are the key differences between private schools and public schools in your country?
3. How severe is traffic congestion in your hometown during rush hours?

questions.answer: When I was younger, I attended a local public school in my hometown from primary school to high school.
questions.example: It only took me ten minutes to go to school by bicycle every morning with my neighbors.
questions.q: 1. Attended a public school or private school
questions.reason: My parents chose it simply because public schools have affordable tuition fees that fit comfortably within our family budget, and it was very close to my house.

questions.answer: The main differences between private and public schools in Vietnam are the tuition fees, class sizes, and facilities.
questions.example: For instance, a public class often has over forty students, whereas private schools may have around twenty-five students with air-conditioned classrooms.
questions.q: 2. Key differences between private and public schools
questions.reason: Private schools cost more, so they are often equipped with modern teaching tools and smaller classes, while public schools follow a standard program with more students.

questions.answer: Traffic congestion in my hometown is quite serious during rush hours, especially in the early morning and late afternoon.
questions.example: For example, a short trip that usually takes fifteen minutes by motorbike can take nearly forty minutes at five o'clock in the evening.
questions.q: 3. Traffic congestion in your hometown during rush hours
questions.reason: There are too many private motorbikes and cars on narrow streets, which causes air pollution, noise, and stress for commuters.

reusedVocab: It takes me ___ minutes to go to school by...

title: Part 2 - Situation 2: Selecting a Tourism Promotion Channel for the City
content:
Situation: Your city's tourism promotion board has allocated a budget to attract domestic and international visitors. The committee is deliberating between three marketing channels:
- Broadcasting promotional commercials on national television (quảng bá qua truyền hình TV)
- Running targeted campaigns on social media platforms (chạy chiến dịch trên mạng xã hội)
- Developing creative content marketing and travel blogging (tiếp thị nội dung và cẩm nang du lịch trải nghiệm)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because it is super easy to launch right away online without waiting months for TV filming or long blog series, and it fits comfortably within the city's budget.

khen2ARE.answer: This option helps domestic and international visitors increase knowledge and broaden their horizons about my city's culture and tourist spots.
khen2ARE.example: For example, a 30-second video showing our city's night street food market and famous bridge on TikTok or Instagram can quickly attract young travelers to book weekend trips here.
khen2ARE.reason: Short social media campaigns are fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society, allowing the board to make the most of new technology to reach millions of travelers worldwide.

chosen.khen3Text: a practical channel to get fast results, promote a friendly city image, and attract more visitors to boost local economic development.
chosen.option: Running targeted campaigns on social media platforms

rejected.option: Broadcasting promotional commercials on national television
rejected.reason: buying commercial time on national television costs too much of the city's budget, and most young travelers today watch videos on their phones instead of TV ads.

rejected.option: Developing creative content marketing and travel blogging
rejected.reason: writing long travel blogs takes a lot of time to build an audience, so this opinion has received little agreement compared to fast social media campaigns.

make the most of new technology

- Promoting international cultural exchange and understanding
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. What negative impacts can excessive tourism (overtourism) inflict on local communities?
2. How can municipal authorities balance tourism revenue with environmental conservation?
3. Should historic heritage sites charge entrance fees to domestic citizens?
title: Part 3 - Topic 2: Developing Sustainable Urban Tourism
content:
Topic: The multifaceted benefits of developing sustainable tourism in cities
Suggestions:
- Stimulating local economic growth and creating jobs
- Preserving historical landmarks and architectural heritage
- Promoting international cultural exchange and understanding
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. What negative impacts can excessive tourism (overtourism) inflict on local communities?
2. How can municipal authorities balance tourism revenue with environmental conservation?
3. Should historic heritage sites charge entrance fees to domestic citizens?

followUps.answer: There are some bad effects of too many tourists, such as traffic jams, loud noise, and environmental damage.
followUps.example: For example, in popular beach cities during summer holidays, beaches are often full of trash and local roads are blocked for hours.
followUps.formula: What -> There are some [Ns], such as...
followUps.q: What negative impacts can excessive tourism (overtourism) inflict on local communities?
followUps.reason: This is because crowded streets make local people feel stressed, and extra plastic waste can damage natural habitats and dirty city parks.

followUps.answer: I think city authorities should limit daily visitor numbers, give heavy fines for littering, and invest in clean public transport.
followUps.example: For instance, a city can encourage tourists to ride shared bicycles or electric buses around the old town instead of private cars.
followUps.q: How can municipal authorities balance tourism revenue with environmental conservation?
followUps.reason: Using electric buses reduces traffic jams and pollution, while strict rules protect green spaces without stopping tourism income.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think historic sites should charge a small entrance fee to local visitors, with free entry for students and seniors.
followUps.example: For example, charging a cheap ticket of twenty thousand dong helps pay tour guides and maintain clean restrooms at a museum.
followUps.q: Should historic heritage sites charge entrance fees to domestic citizens?
followUps.reason: This is because ticket money makes an important contribution to cleaning and repairing old buildings while keeping prices within people's budget.

mindmapPoints.cue: Stimulating local economic growth and creating jobs
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because tourists spend money on hotels, local food, and transport, which improves people's living standard.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for the local economy and small business owners.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Sustainable city tourism helps boost economic development and create more local jobs.

mindmapPoints.cue: Preserving historical landmarks and architectural heritage
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, ticket money from visitors helps local authorities repair ancient temples and keep city museums clean.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to both local culture and future generations.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Developing green tourism helps cities protect old buildings and historical places.

mindmapPoints.cue: Promoting international cultural exchange and understanding
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because meeting foreign visitors gives citizens the chance to gain a deeper understanding of different people, cultures, and traditions.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on international friendship and general knowledge.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Tourism brings cultural exchanges and helps people broaden their mind.

hint.ownIdea: I think that 3 ideas are comprehensive. I cannot think of other ideas.
reusedVocab: gain a deeper understanding of people, culture, and tradition

group: Đề thi thực tế DTU (Ca sáng bổ sung)
title: Part 2 - Situation 3: Prioritizing Factors when Purchasing a House
content:
Situation: You are planning to purchase a new house or apartment for your family. You are contemplating which criterion should be given the highest priority. There are three options:
- The purchase cost and mortgage affordability (giá cả và khả năng tài chính)
- The size and floor area of the property (diện tích và không gian sinh hoạt)
- The geographical location and proximity to facilities (vị trí địa lý và tiện ích xung quanh)
Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because choosing a good location close to my workplace, schools, and local markets saves daily travel time and makes everyday life convenient for the whole family.

khen2ARE.answer: Prioritizing location is advantageous to my family's mental health because it helps us reach a healthy balance between work and family time.
khen2ARE.example: For example, if our apartment is only ten minutes from my office and a supermarket, I can pick up fresh food and have dinner with my family at 6 p.m. instead of sitting in traffic.
khen2ARE.reason: Living near essential facilities helps us relieve stress and reduce fatigue from long daily trips, so everyone can recharge their batteries together at home every evening.

chosen.khen3Text: great for reducing daily pressure for the whole family. This is because living near safe facilities keeps our routine under control, allowing us to feel safe, comfortable, and emotionally balanced.
chosen.option: The geographical location and proximity to facilities

rejected.option: The size and floor area of the property
rejected.reason: buying a large house just for extra floor space often means living far outside the city, so traveling two or three hours on congested roads every day will leave us with no energy left to work, sleep, or take care of ourselves.

rejected.option: The purchase cost and mortgage affordability
rejected.reason: choosing a house only because it is cheap is not wise, because low-priced properties are often in remote or unsafe areas with few nearby schools and hospitals.

group: Đề thi thực tế DTU (Ca sáng bổ sung)
title: Part 3 - Topic 3: Advantages and Challenges of Self-Employment
content:
Topic: The notable benefits and demanding challenges of self-employment
Suggestions:
- Autonomous working schedule and independence from management
- Direct correlation between personal effort and income potential
- Financial instability and heavy entrepreneurial pressure
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. Why are an increasing number of young graduates choosing freelance work or startup ventures?
2. What essential skills are necessary before transitioning to self-employment?
3. Do you think governments should provide financial subsidies for young entrepreneurs?

hint.coreTopic: the advantages and challenges of self-employment

followUps.answer: There are some reasons why young graduates choose freelance work, such as wanting freedom and difficulty finding traditional office jobs.
followUps.example: For example, a young graduate can start an online clothing shop or work as a freelance translator right after finishing university.
followUps.q: Why are an increasing number of young graduates choosing freelance work or startup ventures?
followUps.reason: Many fresh graduates struggle to find jobs because university lessons focus too much on theory, while working for themselves lets them follow their true passion and use modern technology from home.

followUps.answer: There are some essential skills needed for self-employment, such as money management, self-discipline, and customer communication.
followUps.example: For instance, a freelance photographer needs to save money for quiet months and reply to customers politely every day.
followUps.formula: What -> There are some [Ns], such as...
followUps.q: What essential skills are necessary before transitioning to self-employment?
followUps.reason: This is because without a manager, you must manage your own budget, finish deadlines on time, and build trust with clients.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think governments should provide financial support and lower tax rates for young business owners.
followUps.example: For example, local authorities can offer low-interest loans and free business training courses for graduates starting their first company.
followUps.formula: Do you think -> Yes, I think... + Support solution
followUps.q: Do you think governments should provide financial subsidies for young entrepreneurs?
followUps.reason: From a broader perspective, helping new small businesses lowers the risk of losing savings, creates more jobs, and boosts economic development.

mindmapPoints.cue: Autonomous working schedule and independence from management
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because you can choose when and where to work, which reduces commuting stress and helps you reach a healthy balance between work and family time.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for your personal freedom and mental health.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Working for yourself lets you control your own working schedule without a boss watching over you.

mindmapPoints.cue: Direct correlation between personal effort and income potential
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, a freelance designer or small shop owner who trains diligently and finds more clients can raise their monthly income faster than in a fixed office job.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to people who want to improve their living standard.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Self-employed people can earn more money when they work hard.

mindmapPoints.cue: Financial instability and heavy entrepreneurial pressure
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because without market experience, new business owners face a high risk of losing their savings and working long hours alone.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it can have negative effects on their mental health and financial safety.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Running your own business brings unstable monthly income and heavy pressure.

without a boss watching over you
